name: arcify
description: A sidebar extension that replicates Arc browser's tab management system

scripts.build:zip: npm run build && npm run zip
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --config jest.config.js
scripts.test:spaces: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/e2e/spaces.test.js
scripts.test:tabs: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/e2e/tabs.test.js
scripts.test:bookmarks: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/e2e/bookmarks.test.js
scripts.test:drag: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/e2e/drag-drop.test.js
scripts.test:keyboard: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/e2e/keyboard.test.js
scripts.test:options: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/e2e/options.test.js

author: Nisarg Kolhe
